thesis: The podcast argues that modern warfare is shifting toward an increasingly electronic and distributed battlefield where legacy power infrastructure, such as diesel generators running at low capacity, creates detectable thermal and acoustic signatures that make forces vulnerable to targeting. To address this gap, the Army and Chariot Defense are developing a tactical power layer that integrates batteries, power electronics, and microcontrollers to make power distribution smarter and more invisible to the enemy.
